Kysylyn Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Volyn Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Jewish settlement in Kysylyn dates uncertainly, though the community was subordinate to that of Ludmir (Volodymyr-Volynsky, documented elsewhere in this collection) in the 17th century; the population reached 87 in 1784 and grew steadily to 873 (98 percent) by 1897, before declining sharply to 94 by 1921 amid WWI hardship. Following the June 1941 occupation, a ghetto established that November was liquidated on August 12, 1942, when 500 Jews from Kysylyn, Ozyutychi, Kholopychi, and surrounding villages were murdered at the site; a monument was erected there in 1991.
